summary: First test run of Britsmaid property-management Expo app. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests PASSED covering auth (admin/cleaner), role enforcement (cleaner 403 on /dashboard & /invoices), properties CRUD, iCal sync (no feeds -> 400, bad URL -> ok:false), bookings create/overlap 409/auto-cleaning session, calendar, upload+media flow, file auth (401 w/o token, 200 with ?token=), settlement math (owner+bm share == net; split_half halves electricity), OTA report, invoices (BM-YYYY-NNNN numbering, totals 10000->discount 500->+18% GST = 11210, status toggle, empty items 400), owner report + public HTML (unauth, 'Owner Statement' present), user create/deactivate, dashboard. Frontend: login works for both roles, all 4 admin tabs (tab-index/tab-calendar/tab-properties/tab-finance) load correctly. Calendar shows filter chips, month nav, day select. Property detail renders with Statement/Report CTAs. Finance owner-statement shows interactive split card, trend bars, OTA rows (settlement-hero, split-card, trend-card, bookings-breakdown-card, 3 split-segments, 6 trend-bars all present). New invoice flow works end-to-end (BM-2026-XXXX created, total updates live, invoice-view-total & invoice-toggle-paid present on detail). Owner report creation works (creates share token, interactive owner link visible, Share link / Preview buttons). Cleaner login lands on cleaning task list (4 pending cards), session detail shows 6 room cards each with before/after capture tiles, cleaning-complete-button present. No red screens or runtime errors.

ui_bugs.issue: booking-checkin / booking-checkout Pressable not fillable by playwright page.fill (opens a bottom sheet instead). Manual date entry via sheet works; automated setting of dates is cumbersome. Consider exposing hidden input or date-sheet testIDs (e.g. 'date-sheet-day-{YYYY-MM-DD}').

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on react-native-web — switch to 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking console warning observed on every screen.

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated 'shadow*' RN style props with 'boxShadow' to silence web console warnings (ui.tsx, Segmented, etc).
(Optional) Add testIDs inside DateField sheet (e.g. date-sheet-day-YYYY-MM-DD) to make booking date entry automatable; currently the Pressable opens a sheet which playwright can't fill directly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 972 lines — above the 700-line threshold; consider splitting routers (properties/bookings/cleaning/reports/invoices) into separate modules.
property_status helper runs 2 DB queries per property in /api/properties list — fine at seed scale, but could become O(N) hot spot; consider aggregation when properties grow.
settlement endpoint computes 6 months of settlements synchronously (one-by-one); fine for 2 villas, watch perf as properties/bookings grow.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows + testIDs verified; only DateField auto-fill limitation)

seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 2 demo villas + 7 bookings + 1 expense at startup; tests create/cleanup their own TEST_* data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints and critical UI flows verified. Admin cred: admin@britsmaid.com/Britsmaid@2026. Cleaner cred: cleaner@britsmaid.com/Cleaner@2026. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. The DateField component on /booking/new opens a bottom-sheet picker — not directly fillable. Camera capture and native PDF share aren't testable in web preview (expected).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Minor cosmetic deprecation warning for 'shadow*' RN style props on web is expected and non-blocking.
